name: refactoring-ui
title_zh: 把 Refactoring UI 的设计规则变成你的
tagline_zh: 做界面总差口气？用这本书的硬规则查间距、字号、阴影、层级，像老手一样挑出毛病，改完立刻顺眼。
tagline_en: UI still feels off? Apply Refactoring UI's concrete rules to audit spacing, type, shadows, hierarchy—and fix it.
desc_en: Design and improve user interfaces using the concrete rules from Refactoring UI (Wathan & Schoger) — constrained spacing/type/color/shadow scales, visual hierarchy through weight and color rather than size, and depth through emulated light. Use when building or styling any UI (web, app, dashboard, landing page, component), when picking font sizes, spacing, colors, shadows or border radius, when de
why_zh: 不是泛泛而谈，而是把书里的约束尺度、层级对比、光照模拟变成可执行的检查项，直接作用于你的代码。
why_en: Turns the book's concrete scales and light-emulation principles into actionable checks, so you fix UI with intent, not guesswork.
limit_zh: 只覆盖视觉规则（间距/字号/颜色/阴影/圆角），不涉及交互逻辑、动效或无障碍；需要你提供代码或截图，且规则偏静态设计。
limit_en: Covers only visual rules (spacing/type/color/shadow/radius), not interaction, motion, or a11y. Needs code/screenshot input; dynamic states.
